verdict: Yes. Carragreen from Indore pitched eco-friendly boxes on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Businesses must replace single-use plastic, and sustainable packaging is in demand from restaurants, D2C brands and retailers.
angle: Plastic bans and brand sustainability goals push demand for paper, bagasse and seaweed-based packaging. Food delivery and D2C brands are large buyers. Price and quality must be close to plastic.
